publications.title: Synthesis, antimicrobial evaluation, and integrated DFT, molecular docking, and dynamics simulation studies of the novel pentanoylated methyl α-D-mannopyranoside derivatives
publications.summary: Synthesised new sugar-based (mannopyranoside) derivatives as candidates against antimicrobial resistance, tested them against bacterial and fungal pathogens, and used DFT, docking and dynamics simulations to explain their activity.
highlights: Funded by Ministry of Science and Technology, Government of Bangladesh

publications.title: In Silico Identification of Potent SARS-CoV-2 RdRp Inhibitors: DFT and Molecular Docking Analysis of Acylated Glucopyranoside Derivatives
publications.journal: The Chittagong University Journal of Science
publications.summary: Computationally designed and evaluated modified glucopyranoside (sugar) derivatives as possible inhibitors of the SARS-CoV-2 RNA polymerase, combining DFT, docking and ADMET safety predictions.

publications.title: Toward efficient and sustainable perovskite solar cells: a combined first-principles and device simulation study of K2LiGa(Cl/Br)6 for photovoltaic performance optimization
publications.titleHtml: Toward efficient and sustainable perovskite solar cells: a combined first-principles and device simulation study of K<sub>2</sub>LiGa(Cl/Br)<sub>6</sub> for photovoltaic performance optimization
publications.summary: Evaluated two lead-free double halide perovskites as solar-cell absorbers by pairing first-principles (DFT) calculations with SCAPS-1D device simulation to optimise photovoltaic performance.

publications.title: DFT Computation, Molecular Docking, MD Simulation, and Pharmacokinetic Analyses of Potent Glucopyranoside Derivatives Targeting DENV2 RdRp and Escherichia coli DNA GyrB
publications.titleHtml: DFT Computation, Molecular Docking, MD Simulation, and Pharmacokinetic Analyses of Potent Glucopyranoside Derivatives Targeting DENV2 RdRp and Escherichia coli DNA GyrB
publications.summary: Screened previously synthesised glucopyranoside derivatives against two targets at once — the dengue virus (DENV2) RNA polymerase and a DNA gyrase enzyme of antibiotic-resistant E. coli — using DFT, docking, MD simulations and pharmacokinetic predictions.
highlights: Dual target: dengue virus + drug-resistant E. coli
First-author, two-author paper with his supervisor

publications.title: Uridine Derivatives as Potential Human Gene Protein Inhibitors
publications.bookTitle: Chemistry and Biochemistry: Research Progress Vol. 8
publications.summary: Explores modified uridine (nucleoside) molecules as inhibitors of human uridine phosphorylase, an approach aimed at reducing the toxicity of the cancer drug 5-fluorouracil.

publications.title: Exploring Potential COX-2 Inhibitors of Ibuprofen Derivatives: Integrating DFT, Molecular Docking, Molecular Dynamics Simulations, ADMET with FEL and MMPBSA Analyses
publications.summary: Designed 14 ibuprofen derivatives by replacing the carboxylic acid group (linked to ibuprofen's side effects) with acyl and amide groups. DFT, docking, MD simulations and ADMET screening showed most derivatives bind COX-2 more strongly than ibuprofen, with compound I7 standing out.
highlights: Ibuprofen: -7.3 kcal/mol vs best derivatives I7: -9.0 and I9: -8.8 kcal/mol
I7–COX-2 complex binding free energy (MMPBSA): -78.02 kJ/mol
Favourable predicted drug-likeness and lower toxicity

publications.title: DFT/TD-DFT study of novel triphenylamine-based dyes with azo moieties and π-spacer variations for enhanced dye-sensitized solar cell performance
publications.summary: Designed new triphenylamine-based dyes with azo groups for dye-sensitised solar cells and used DFT/TD-DFT to show how the modifications broaden light absorption and tune their electronic and optical properties.
highlights: His first publication — from his undergraduate years
Dyes also show promise for nonlinear optics
